title: Regularity of equations in the polynomial closed fibre
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $f_1,\ldots,f_c\in P=R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ a specified relative global complete-intersection presentation [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. Let $Q$ be a prime of $P$ containing $(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$, $p=Q\cap R$, and $B=P_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. If $I$ is the extension of the maximal ideal of $R_p$ under its canonical local map to $B$, then the images of the $f_i/1$ form a regular sequence in $B/I$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence].

source.place: 00SV first paragraph, the application of 00SC to the closed polynomial fibre.

proof.text: Obtain Qk and the natural equation-preserving ring isomorphism B/I = k[x]_{Qk} from the polynomial closed-fibre equivalence. Qk contains the coefficient images of the equations because its contraction is Q.

Base change the specified presentation to k=kappa(p). Over any field the fibre at its zero prime is the quotient itself: the field is canonically isomorphic to its residue field, and tensoring with itself is the identity. Thus the relative complete-intersection hypothesis gives c <= n and global quotient dimension n-c. The prime Qk makes this quotient nonzero.

Rewrite dimension as dimension+c=n and apply the field-case global-complete-intersection local-regular-sequence theorem. Transport the regular sequence back along the equation-preserving isomorphism, using multiplication compatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem isRegular_closedFiber_of_relativeCompleteIntersection
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n c : ℕ}
    (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (h : IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersectionPresentation f)
    (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) [Q.IsPrime]
    (hQ : Ideal.span (Set.range f) ≤ Q) :
    let p := Q.comap (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))
    let φ := Localization.localRingHom p Q (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) rfl
    let I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p)).map φ
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ I)
      (((List.ofFn f).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.AtPrime Q))).map
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
